gen-gf-barriecito-gf-suwannaphum: Barriecito tips its bowls open like a ladle, big and bodied. Suwannaphum, the text serif beneath, stands high like squared-off woodblock letters and gives all that exuberance a dignified, editorial footing.
gen-gf-battambang-gf-epunda-slab: Squeezed ascenders, open-jawed curves: Battambang has a look all its own, and it makes the heading hard to ignore. Epunda Slab, a serif, brings a gaping c and tall, rounded lowercase.
gen-gf-battambang-gf-fauna-one: Expressive from the very first glance, Battambang compresses its ascenders and leaves every curved stroke gaping open. In Fauna One, a tall middle band keeps long, literary text flowing.
gen-gf-battambang-gf-glegoo: Distinctive is the word for Battambang, with compressed ascenders and open jaws on every curve. Glegoo then fills tall lowercase with big counters and wide, unclosed mouths, comfortable at a generous body size.
gen-gf-battambang-gf-graduate: Battambang compresses its ascenders and opens a wide jaw on every curve, distinctive and individual. Graduate, a serif with generous spacing and uniform stems and joins, feels bookish and dignified next to it.
gen-gf-battambang-gf-hanuman: Distinctive from the start, Battambang squeezes its ascenders short and gives every curved stroke open jaws. Hanuman, the traditional text serif, has a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set s terminals.
gen-gf-battambang-gf-kadwa: Expressive without being wide, Battambang keeps its ascenders compressed while every curved stroke opens its jaws. Kadwa lands it softly with open-ended curves, a large x-height, editorial air.
gen-gf-battambang-gf-piazzolla: Tight ascenders, open jaws: Battambang is all attitude. Piazzolla, refined throughout, has lowercase nearly matching its capitals and a pried-open e, so paragraphs run on with steady, authoritative confidence.
gen-gf-battambang-gf-pridi: Pridi stands proud, its small letters almost capital-sized. Battambang does the shouting with compressed ascenders and open jaws, while Pridi, the text serif, quietly handles the reading with generous space around its curves.
gen-gf-battambang-gf-scope-one: Distinctive up top, Battambang shortens its ascenders and cuts open jaws into every single curved stroke. Scope One, traditional, anchors it with stubby ascenders beside a big x-height.
